newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa estimates cut.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said it has lowered its earnings estimates for Brazilian steelmaker Cia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa).
-- It said in a statement that it reduced its 1996 estimate for Cosipa to a loss of $0.18 from breakeven and its 1997 forecast to a $0.15 loss from its prior estimate of a $0.17 profit.
-- It cited lower-than-expected domestic market sales, lower export prices and higher fixed and operating costs.
-- Bear Stearns said it has not rated Cosipa.
-- Cosipa's preferred B share was flat at 0.64 real while its voting common was untraded at 1523 local/1423 EDT on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
